Postdoc in Software Engineering and Open Source Security at Polytechnic Institute of Paris

Télécom Paris, engineering school member of the Polytechnic Institute of Paris, is hiring a postdoctoral researcher, for 30 months in the field(s) of software engineering and cybersecurity.

Télécom Paris is participating in the research project SECUBIC (SEcure BInary supply Chain) to improve the security of binary executables that include open source components. As part of the SECUBIC project, the ACES team of Télécom Paris will develop techniques and tools that leverage Software Heritage, the largest archive of source code in the world, as knowledge base about open source software to improve the state of the art of binary software composition analysis (SCA).

See the complete job description for additional details: English version, French version.

Application deadline: 31 August 2025

Contact: Stefano Zacchiroli, stefano.zacchiroli@telecom-paris.fr.
